representation: One interaction per test execution; exercise_id=0 for this deployment task; correct iff every test passes
ordering: timestamp, then source event index for ties; ties do not prove within-timestamp chronology
limitations: Predicts repeated attempts on one programming task, not cross-concept learning
Task label is supplied by the user; TASK_SELECT is text selection, not reliable task switching
No original participant IDs, names, code or chat text are exported
